player_prompt.intro:
Ngeye Mwana {player_id}. Ngeye wakulaba Mwana Memory.
Kulaba kwenu, kubika mikwaju miwili ya kusema kwa kubika nambari ya safu na safu ya kwanza na ya pili ya mikwaju, kama '[0 1 1 0]', ambapo kwanza mikwaju iko safu 0 na safu 1, na ya pili mikwaju iko safu 1 na safu 0.
Ikiwa mikwaju miwili ikilingana, ngeye kupata alama na mikwaju ikasalia juu. Ikiwa hailingani, mikwaju ikatolewa chini, mfano '.'.
Mwana ukomeka wakati mikwaju yote imepatikana.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Muena manaya {player_id} kavua muandamune ne njila muimpe to.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Muena manaya {player_id} udi usungula muaba wa pambelu pa mukuna.
invalid_move.same_card_twice: Muena manaya {player_id} udi usungula karte kamue misangu ibidi.
invalid_move.already_matched: Muena manaya {player_id} udi usungula umue anyi yonso ibidi ya ku karte aka kadi kale kupetangana.

game_message.cards_match: Mikwaju iliyochaguliwa na Mwana {player_id} katika nafasi [{r1} {c1}] na [{r2} {c2}] inalingana!
game_message.cards_no_match: Mikwaju iliyochaguliwa na Mwana {player_id} haipatani. Mikwaju katika nafasi [{r1} {c1}] na [{r2} {c2}] ni {pos1} na {pos2} mtawalia.

outcome.draw: Wana wote wawili walipata idadi sawa ya mikwaju.
outcome.turn_limit: Muda wa kwenda umefikia. Mwana umekwisha. Mwana 0 alipata {score_0} alama, Mwana 1 alipata {score_1} alama.
